AC amendment (gap analysis #2 - implicit_assumption): Fix fixture schema. synthetic-findings.json MUST mirror the Step-4 exchange-artifact shape with top-level keys sc_coverage_summary, red_team_findings, blue_team_accepted, blue_team_rejected — where blue_team_accepted contains findings. Replace the existing AC verify with:
Verify: jq -e '.blue_team_accepted.findings | length > 0' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/tests/fixtures/phase-e/synthetic-findings.json
Otherwise the gate-under-test (blue_team_accepted.findings non-empty) is meaningless.
